notes.title: Potatogeddon – Official Release
notes.notes:
The wait is over, Potatogeddon is here! Step into the chaotic world of a fearless potato hero as they battle through bug labs, twisted dungeons, and dangerous arenas filled with bizarre enemies and deadly traps. Designed for both solo players and co-op duos, Potatogeddon combines fast-paced shooting, dungeon crawling, and quirky humor in one explosive package.



The current version of the game already includes, among others, the following mechanics:
[hr][/hr]Key Features at LaunchWeapons & Combat
A full weapon system with unique playstyles.

Blue Pulse – the classic starter weapon.

Verdant Burst – boosts max HP and strength at the cost of fire rate.

Twin Flare – fires two projectiles at once with reduced speed.

Active energy-based items that can turn the tide of battle:

Phantom Shield – temporary invincibility.

Soil of Rage – unleash rapid-fire fury.

Decoytato – distracts or explodes among enemies.

Every weapon and item changes player stats, making each run unique.
[hr][/hr]Procedural Rooms & Challenges
Every run offers a new labyrinth of dangers and surprises:

Rootlink Rooms – destroy the core before you can damage enemies.

Pressure Plate & Platform Rooms – solve puzzles while fighting off swarms.

Lava Rooms – hazardous arenas where both players and enemies can burn.

Puzzle Rooms – environmental challenges that mix combat with clever mechanics.
[hr][/hr]Enemies & Bosses
Face a bizarre lineup of mutated foes and colossal bosses:

Face a bizarre lineup of mutated foes and colossal bosses:

Creepy enemies like Aphidoodle and flying threats like Fly and Green Fly.

Other twisted abominations such as Microtarsa, Chomprax, Laptobettle, and the armored Cannon.

Three unique bosses, each with their own attack patterns:

Beetle Prime – guardian of Level 1.

Glowgrub – the burrowing menace of Level 2.

Aphidra – a devastating insect overlord on Level 3.
[hr][/hr]Multiplayer Co-Op
Team up with a friend in 2-player co-op (with 3–4 player support planned for the future).

Voice chat with push-to-talk, volume control, and animated mouth movement for characters.

Spectator mode for late joiners and fallen players.

Revive system – bring your teammate back into the fight by holding the action button.
[hr][/hr]Progression & Unlocks
Game saving in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

Character stats – track your best runs, deaths, and victories.

Unlockable characters like Cyclotato after completing Chapter 1.

Chapters system:

Chapter 1 introduces the adventure.

Chapter 2 spans six levels and unlocks Chapter 3 – an endless challenge for hardcore players.
[hr][/hr]Extra Features
Polish language support alongside English.

Shops with randomized prices, offering items and upgrades mid-run.

Optimized maps and performance – no more wasted rendering, smoother gameplay even at higher levels.

Enhanced audio & visual polish – footsteps, explosions, lava effects, voice chat animations, and more.
[hr][/hr]
